description: Explicitly reviewed source identities for truncated or renamed ARTIST symbols. Exact C++ symbol and body file only; no prefix/leaf inference.

rw::audio::core::GinsuPlayer::EventEvent.evidence: GinsuPlayer.h and cpp identify vt[1] at this address; Event queues play/stop handlers with host-sized deferred records. EventEvent is the ledger spelling.

rw::graphics::postfx::ColourCub.evidence: CgsResourcePtr_rw_graphics_postfx_ColourCube.cpp explicitly instantiates GetMemoryResource; baked assertion line 581 identifies the accessor, rather than operator-> or operator*.

rw::math::vpu::Vector3>::Push.evidence: RingBuffer_Vector3.cpp explicitly instantiates the generic body and documents ARTIST offsets, 16-byte element stride, cursor advance and full-buffer handling.

rw::math::vpu::Vector3>::operator[].evidence: RingBuffer_Vector3.cpp explicitly instantiates the non-const accessor; ARTIST range assertion, modulo indexing and 16-byte stride match the generic body.

rw::math::vpu::Vector3>::Record.evidence: Explicit vector specialization documents this exact truncated IDA name and AIPhysicsControl caller; writes sample, wraps modulo 9, sums lanes and scales by 1/9.

CgsSceneManager::SceneManagerIO::OutEven.evidence: PostOffice header enumerates this emitted Deliver instantiation; ARTIST asserts slot bounds/non-null then calls TakePackage.
SceneManagerModuleIO.h pins the two-word sphere-result payload from this exact TakePackage address; generic PostBox checks WAITING, copies payload and sets GOT_PACKAGE.
